subject: afi
title: AFI.------(R)PART.OR.POST.
description: Chart on book p. 248 (CMOA(II)-6). AFI (affinity insight) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PART-OR-POST is the partner, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From the subject: COS-ASN. From PART-OR-POST: SI (source initiation). AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) is on a dotted line from PART-OR-POST. From COS-ASN: PRI-INFO (principle information). From SI: OP-SPD (option spread). From PRI-INFO: PART-OR-POST.
